scope: True cold p0=0; planar and cylindrical-radial one-dimensional finite volumes, not Cartesian 2D. Fixed pre-run acceptance retained.

noh-shock.origin: reflecting parity; cylindrical origin face has zero area
noh-shock.outer_boundary: time-dependent analytic cold inflow evaluated at boundary face
noh-shock.geometric_source: arithmetic face quadrature of interfacial Rusanov normal stress F_mom-u_face*F_mass, multiplied by (A_right-A_left)
noh-shock.spatial_claim: 1D planar and 1D cylindrical-radial symmetry only; no Cartesian 2D Euler calculation
